resolved_by: Supreme Court, Hunter v. United States, 146 S. Ct. 1702 (2026)
issue: Can a sentencing appeal waiver be enforced if enforcing it would result in a miscarriage of justice, and what error is needed to meet that exception?
this_court: applies the Supreme Court's Hunter rule and enforces the appeal waiver, dismissing the appeal
quote: In Hunter v. United States, resolving a circuit split, the Supreme Court held that in the sentencing context an appeal waiver “cannot be enforced if doing so would result in a miscarriage of justice.” 146 S. Ct. 1702, 1709 (2026).
cite: United States v. Xavier Murry, No. 25-1410 (8th Cir. 2026)
